scenarios.source:
test "the name is required"
  expect applicant_name required
  check
  expect refused
  expect error on applicant_name: required

test "the age has a floor"
  set applicant_name = "Ada"
  set age = 15
  check
  expect refused
  expect error on age: number.min
  set age = 30
  check
  expect accepted

test "the nickname follows the box"
  expect nickname hidden
  set wants_details = true
  expect nickname visible

test "a scenario kept for later"
  skip "waiting on the address rules"
  expect applicant_name visible
